## Atomic notes

- [[Final shared atom]]

classifiedDiagnostics: Expected Electron application CSP unsafe-eval warning; no security headers changed.
Expected denied MCP proposal and invalid-vector query warnings.
Android WebView variation-seed and EGL fallback/overlay diagnostics, without plugin errors.

First Android emulator host process exited -11 after QEMU virtual CPU stall warnings; recovered with one virtual CPU, reran full final suite, shut down with exit 0. Resource contention is suspected, not established.

Harness corrections: localized labels, wrong source-card selector, tied mock search ranking, modal document/stack targeting, stale editor fixture, identical-content mobile repeat fixture. All affected assertions were corrected and rerun.
Local cross-device git hardlinks and SDK package-discovery setup failures were environmental; independent clone used --no-hardlinks and the official image booted successfully.

Android logcat also contains x86 CPU-variant/JDWP, Bluetooth permission, predictive-back and missing Custom Tabs capability diagnostics; these are native app/emulator capabilities, not plugin JavaScript failures.

Android native app logged 62 resource-close warnings in two bursts and rendering/frame/IME timeouts. Logs provide no allocation owner or stack, so their cause is unproven. Functional cases complete, but these observations are retained as a limitation on native leak/performance claims.

limitations: Mock embeddings are identical deterministic vectors: request, storage, retrieval and UI smoke only; no retrieval-quality claim.
Twenty command registrations and start/cancel paths were checked; the full Deep Audit and MOC generation workflows were not exhaustively evaluated.
No paid provider endpoints, external Qdrant deployment, iOS, Windows/macOS or physical Android device was tested.
No heap/handle profiler or exhaustive long-duration leak proof. Event/command/ribbon counts remained stable in the measured cycles.
Streaming uses fetch and requires provider CORS; buffered requestUrl timeout does not guarantee physical network cancellation. Existing incremental streaming can leave partial output on cancellation.
Hosted Obsidian rescan and release attestations were not executed.
Original forensic evidence remains historical. This file records subsequent runtime verification.
Android native resource-close warnings and rendering delays were not attributed to an allocation owner; no claim of leak-free native framework behavior or smooth physical-device performance.
